_comment: Declares the 5 context scopes for this project. Read by session-start.sh + /expand-studio + /deep-research + /bootstrap. Claude uses this to decide what to proactively orient on at session start and what to lazy-load. The actual scope in effect is stored in .claude/.current-scope (written by /bootstrap, /expand-studio, /contract-scope).

minimal.description: Bare minimum. Fastest session startup. For quick edits + terminal tasks.
available_on_demand: All existing blueprint tooling is PRESENT but not orienting Claude at session start. Claude invokes tools when tasks require them.
minimal.typical_use: Hotfix commit, doc typo, CI config tweak — you know what you want to do; no orientation needed.

standard.description: Existing blueprint v1 behavior. Core docs + base slash commands + hooks + CHANGELOG.
available_on_demand: Rules lazy-load per-path via frontmatter matching
standard.typical_use: Typical Phase 1-3 dev work — project framework + mechanics

rich.description: DEFAULT for 1M-context tier. Standard + 14-agent studio + 25 extended slash commands + 17 rules + statusline + unity-check/state-dump skills.
available_on_demand: 14 agents via Agent tool (creative-director, technical-director, producer, game-designer, lead-programmer, art-director, narrative-director, qa-lead, gameplay-programmer, engine-programmer, systems-designer, ui-programmer, unity-specialist, unity-ui-specialist)
Core skills: unity-check, state-dump, unity-webgl-builder, github-pages-deploy, unity-audio-generator
Status line reports phase + task + context% + git branch
rich.typical_use: Phase 3-7 active dev work on a 1M-context tier. Recommended default.

studio.description: Rich + studio-expansion. Additional specialists, sprint management rigor, all optional patterns. Opt-in via /expand-studio.
available_on_demand: Extended agent roster (audio-director, ai-programmer, technical-artist, level-designer, writer, world-builder, accessibility-specialist, devops-engineer, unity-shader-specialist, unity-dots-specialist, unity-addressables-specialist, localization-lead — spawn on demand)
All game-ai-runtime patterns (claude-runtime / dialogue-runtime / npc-memory / safety-filters)
studio.typical_use: Larger-scope projects, small team, or when Phase 6-7 content-scaling is in full swing.

research.description: Studio + full reference library loaded. For heavy-research phases (Phase 0 kickoff, Phase 2 design bible, Phase 8 launch prep). Opt-in via /deep-research.
proactively_load: references/*-CATALOG.md (what exists in the cloned reference repos)
available_on_demand: references/donchitos/, references/hcg-workflows/, references/hermetic/, references/davila7/ — read any of their source files for deep patterns
Full blueprint library available for quotation
research.typical_use: Authoring a design bible that needs breadth + cross-referencing. Heavy launch preparation. Architectural decision that spans many domains.

scope_promotions._comment: Rules for automatic scope elevation based on current phase + tier-capabilities.json

context_budget_targets._comment: Rough KB loaded at session start (proactive_load only, not on-demand). Context headroom = 1M tokens ≈ 4MB; target budget for proactive-load stays well under 10% of that.
context_budget_targets.research: ~800 KB — intended for 1M-context tier sessions only
